methodology.scope: 30 displayed questions, one sequential live API call each, selected completed my-documents job, top_k=5 chunks; no automatic retries. Existing ingestion was inspected and checksum-verified, not rerun.
methodology.answer_pass: The direct answer to the question is correct. Minor omitted qualifiers are called out in notes. Additional material false claims or omission of a material condition prevent a full pass.
methodology.citation_pass: Cited passages support the substantive factual claims. Partial means some support is correct but a claim uses the wrong excerpt or lacks a needed citation. Fail means core support is absent or incorrectly attributed.
methodology.reviewer: Codex manually compared every answer and its cited excerpts with the synthetic corpus. This is not a keyword-only automatic judge or an independent human review.
methodology.document_retrieval_metric: Document-level source coverage within the five returned chunks; finding the document does not establish retrieval of the required passage.
methodology.limitations: Small synthetic corpus: 12 documents and 52 indexed chunks. One run; no statistical robustness, throughput, ACL enforcement, OCR, or unsupported-format quality claim. Existing library data and settings were not changed. Generation completion does not prove factual correctness.
